rationale: The recurrent-tail 9x512 line is still the local winner, and recent recurrence/traversal edits have mostly flattened out. This run spends a small amount of the remaining size headroom on the existing output-side bigram residual instead of another tail-control sweep: it raises the default bigram rank from 64 to 80, routes every non-block non-embedding parameter through Adam so the enlarged bigram factors cannot silently fall out of optimization, and explicitly keeps the bigram factor matrices in FP16 for quant-aware roundtrip and final int8+zlib export. The hot transformer path, wallclock behavior, exact eval path, and recurrent-tail quantization budget stay otherwise unchanged.
title: Widen Bigram Residual And Keep It Export-Safe
